stimulus.target_action: Riley places two wood slabs on Riley's side of the planning table, adds one sign block, and steps back to look across the table.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the center of the planning table and faces Riley without moving for several seconds. Morgan swings an empty hand three times toward the sign Riley placed. Morgan drops a stack of rotten flesh at Riley's feet, breaks one wood slab on Riley's side of the table, then turns back to face Riley again.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey steps into the gap beside Riley, replaces the broken slab, places an item frame along Riley’s edge, and holds position shoulder-to-shoulder with Riley facing the center tile.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves along the observer line to x=0, z=-2, pauses facing Morgan and Riley, then repairs the broken wood slab and picks up the rotten flesh to place it into the shared chest before stepping back to the observer line.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves between Morgan and Riley, picks up the rotten flesh, repairs the broken wood slab, places a short divider line of slabs centered between their stations, sets a neutral sign with arrows marking each side, and taps the signal lamp on then off.

target_reaction: Riley steps back two blocks from the contested spot, looks down to avoid eye contact, crouches, picks up only the dropped rotten flesh, walks to the shared chest at x=0, z=-5, opens it, deposits the rotten flesh, closes the chest, returns to the neutral edge of Riley’s station, stands at a slight angle toward Casey and Taylor, and resumes by placing one non-contested slab on Riley’s side while leaving Morgan’s altered area untouched.
